images.title: Thread at three positions
images.purpose: Show three rectangles 7 cm by 4 cm, each with a thread from the left side to the right side, and the length read for each.
images.composition: Three small identical rectangles in a row with wide gaps, each with one amber thread and one reading below.
images.exact_structure: Three identical rectangles 7 cm by 4 cm, outlines teal #0072B2. Each has one amber #E69F00 thread from its left side to its right side. First: left end 5 mm up, right end 3 cm up, thread tilted. Second: both ends 1 cm up, thread flat. Third: left end 2 cm up, right end 4 cm up, thread tilted. Below each, one reading. Exactly 3 rectangles, 3 threads, 3 readings.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
threads that do not touch the sides, or a flat thread drawn tilted
images.takeaway: A tilted thread reads a little more than 7 cm; a flat one reads exactly 7 cm.
images.description: Three rectangles with a thread in each: two tilted, one flat, read as 7 cm 4 mm, 7 cm 0 mm and 7 cm 3 mm.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say which thread is flat and why it reads exactly 7 cm.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
